blocks.text: جمل أطول ومفردات أقلّ شيوعًا. الكلمات الجديدة في معظمها مشروحة أدناه.
Why does he want all this?
Why does Tom want all this?
Why does he like doing that?
Why does she need to do this?
What does Tom think about this?
Tom doesn't want me here, does he?
blocks.note: توم لا يريدني هنا. أليس كذلك؟

blocks.text: He does think he's too good for us.
blocks.note: هو حقا يعتقد أنه أرقى مستوى منّا.

blocks.text: Who is this Yanni and where does he come from?
blocks.note: من يكون ياني هذا و من أين هو؟

blocks.text: The TV is on all day.
Some day, you will see me.
